# TABLES.txt - tables the rules of TechDiag take a value from (K19, RULES-FORMAT.md 2a). Made By Tzahi Bocal.
# Its place: <home>\TechDiag\Knowledge\TABLES.txt, beside RULES-VENDOR.txt. It is data only - nothing in it is run.
# Written by tools/mk_biostables.py - do not edit by hand; run the script again.
#
#   DATE  | the date of this file (DD/MM/YYYY)
#   TABLE | id | vendor | document id | version (- = none given) | DD/MM/YYYY | URL
#   ROW   | table id | key | value
#
# The keys and the values are facts (a BIOS family or a model name, and a version number), taken from the makers'
# own documents; the makers' words are not copied here. A rule names a table by its id:
#   WHEN | <rule> | bios.version | TVLT | <table id> BY bios.family
#
# HP-SB2023-MIN: the minimum BIOS per BIOS family, from the table of minimum BIOS versions in HP's document named
# (no version or date on the page; the date is the day it was read). Key: the BIOS family (bios.family).
# DELL-SB2023-MIN: the minimum BIOS version with the 2023 certificate per model, from Dell's KB 000347876 version 20
# (last modified 23/05/2026). Key: the model as pc.model holds it ("Dell " + Dell's platform name).
DATE | 13/11/2026
